cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

mechanism: A uses controlled personal admissions as diagnostic prompts, correcting B's description of a friendship injury to elicit its motive.
confusable: A confession for comfort differs from bait; each admission should cause a more exact motive question, shaped by S03's precision.
comparison: Hidden invitation and jealousy differ from a former colleague's route around a station.
seedUse: Keep mutual jealousy disclosures; replace detached professional talk with corrections of action versus motive and exaggerated frequency.
